language.name: English
help.title: 🎶 **DJ Snake commands**
help.cmd.play: `{prefix}play <link or text>`: play a YouTube, SoundCloud, Bandcamp, Spotify, Deezer or Apple Music link, a YouTube live, a Twitch channel or an internet radio, or the best YouTube match for some text
help.cmd.voteskip: `{prefix}voteskip`: vote to skip the current track (`threshold <1-100>` sets the share of votes needed, DJs only)
help.cmd.seek: `{prefix}seek <position>`: jump to a position (seconds or mm:ss)
help.cmd.crossfade: `{prefix}crossfade on|off`: blend each track into the next
help.cmd.stop: `{prefix}stop`: stop, clear the queue and leave the voice channel
help.cmd.language: `{prefix}language [code|reset]`: language of the bot and the clip page (Manage Server)
help.cmd.loop: `{prefix}loop [off|track|queue]`: repeat the track or the queue (empty cycles)
help.cmd.volume: `{prefix}volume [0-150]`: show or set the server's volume
help.cmd.autoplay: `{prefix}autoplay [on|off]`: keep playing related tracks when the queue runs out
help.cmd.filter: `{prefix}filter [preset]`: show or set the audio filter ({presets}; `eq` takes low mid high)
help.cmd.stay: `{prefix}stay [on|off]`: 24/7 mode, stay in the voice channel even when idle
help.cmd.playlist: `{prefix}playlist save|add|load|show|delete|export <name>`, `{prefix}playlist import <name> <link>` (or with a file attached), `{prefix}playlist list`: saved playlists of the server
help.cmd.djrole: `{prefix}djrole [role|off]`: the role that may control the music (Manage Server)
help.cmd.weblink: `{prefix}weblink`: get the clip page links by direct message

`{prefix}filter <preset>` changes it: {presets}. `{prefix}filter eq <low> <mid> <high>` sets the equaliser (-12 to 12 dB).

cmd.stay_on_later: 🌙 24/7 mode on: I will stay in the voice channel I join next. Join one and use `{prefix}play`.
cmd.stay_off: 🌙 24/7 mode off: I leave voice when the queue stays empty.
